PROGRAM
  TYPE_DEF
    IDENT "type"
    LBRACE "{"
    IDENT "Person"
    COMMA ","
    IDENT "City"
    RBRACE "}"
    DEFINE ":="
    EXPR
      POSTFIX_EXPR
        POSTFIX_EXPR
          LITERAL_EXPR
            IDENT "io"
          DOT "."
          IDENT "shex"
        LPAREN "("
        ARG_LIST
          ARG
            LITERAL_EXPR
              STRING "\"personas.shex\""
        RPAREN ")"
  SOURCE_DEF
    IDENT "type"
    DEFINE ":="
    EXPR
      POSTFIX_EXPR
        POSTFIX_EXPR
          LITERAL_EXPR
            IDENT "io"
          DOT "."
          IDENT "csv"
        LPAREN "("
        ARG_LIST
          ARG
            LITERAL_EXPR
              STRING "\"type.csv\""
        RPAREN ")"
  MAPPING
    MAPPING_HEADER
      IDENT "Users"
      SHAPE_SEP ":"
      SHAPE_EXPR
        IDENT "Person"
      KW_FROM "from"
      EXPR
        LITERAL_EXPR
          IDENT "type"
    MAPPING_BODY
      PROPERTY
        PROPERTY_LHS
          AT_ATTR "@subject"
        ASSIGN "="
        EXPR
          POSTFIX_EXPR
            LITERAL_EXPR
              IDENT "type"
            DOT "."
            IDENT "id"
